shared_elements: human figures shown in strict profile
bearded male figures with elaborate headgear/caps
low-relief frieze on a horizontal band
figures processing/moving in one direction across the panel
patterned hair and beard rendered in regular rows of curls
hands holding objects (bow/reins vs. spears/hands clasped)
justification: Both are continuous low-relief friezes of bearded male figures in strict profile with formulaic, tightly stylised curled hair and beards, all oriented in one direction along a horizontal band, which is a fairly specific shared convention. However, A depicts a violent narrative hunt with a chariot, galloping horses and attacking and dying lions, while B depicts a static, repetitive file of standing attendants between rosette borders, with no animals, no vehicles and no action.
